title: The Calmest One Is Already Leaving
hook: THE CALMEST ONE IS ALREADY LEAVING

steps.hook: The calmest person in the room... is usually the one already leaving.
steps.curiosity: And you won't see it coming. Here's why.
steps.build: They didn't forget what you did. They just stopped arguing about it. Every excuse, they heard. Every broken promise, they counted. Their silence isn't weakness. It's a decision being made.
steps.payoff: So when someone finally goes quiet... don't call it peace. It's the goodbye you didn't hear.
